question: The film ' Thalaivii ', which was released in September 2021, is the official biopic based on the life of _____ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**J Jayalalithaa.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The film ' Thalaivii '**, which was released in September 2021, is the official biopic based on the life of **J Jayalalithaa.**
